search outage notes (rough)

- thurs 5 nov, ~09:40 UTC customers started reporting search returning nothing on the storefront
- nobody got paged. support escalated to us at 10:05 after ~15 tickets
- arjun found the search-indexer had been crashlooping since the 09:30 release, OOMKilled
- the release bumped the indexer batch size from 500 to 5000 docs, memory limit stayed at 2Gi
- index went stale, then the alias flipped to an empty index when the nightly rebuild job ran early
- 10:20 arjun reverted the batch size, pods stable
- 10:50 reindex finished, search back to normal
- we had no alert on indexer restarts or on index doc count
- todo: add alert on indexer crashloop (arjun)
- todo: block the alias flip if the new index doc count is < 90% of the old one
